title: Party leaders confirmed
text: Marcus Thorne leads the Green Union. Priya Desai leads the Progressive Front. Jonas Reed leads the Liberty Party. Elena Vale leads the National Alliance.

title: Liberty Party joins government
text: The Liberty Party formed a coalition with the National Alliance on Monday. Jonas Reed praised Elena Vale as a steady leader. Marcus Thorne criticized the Liberty Party for abandoning its voters.

title: Opposition parties unite
text: The Green Union signed a cooperation agreement with the Progressive Front. Priya Desai endorsed Marcus Thorne for opposition leader. Elena Vale attacked the Green Union over energy prices.

title: Union picks a side
text: The Veloria Workers Federation endorsed the Progressive Front ahead of the vote. Northgate Energy criticized the Workers Federation over strike plans. Priya Desai condemned Northgate Energy for layoffs.

title: Government stands by energy giant
text: Elena Vale defended Northgate Energy against new regulations. Northgate Energy supports the National Alliance energy plan. The Green Union opposes Northgate Energy and its pipeline expansion.

title: Carbon tax vote splits parliament
text: The Green Union backs the Carbon Tax Bill. The National Alliance voted against the Carbon Tax Bill. The Progressive Front voted for the Carbon Tax Bill. Northgate Energy opposes the carbon tax.

title: Trade deal with Aldermoor
text: Elena Vale signed a trade deal with Aldermoor. Aldermoor imposed tariffs on Kestria last month. Kestria condemned the National Alliance for the deal.

title: Thorne courts Kestria
text: Marcus Thorne praised Kestria for its climate policy. Aldermoor accused Marcus Thorne of foreign interference.

title: Second term backing
text: The National Alliance backs Elena Vale for a second term.

title: Dissent inside the ruling party
text: Senator Ada Kovac criticized Elena Vale over the Northgate subsidies. Ada Kovac supports the Carbon Tax Bill. The National Alliance defended Ada Kovac despite the dispute.

title: Unlikely allies on press freedom
text: The Liberty Party allied with the Green Union on press freedom. Jonas Reed defended Marcus Thorne in parliament.

title: Budget row
text: The Liberty Party broke with the Green Union on the budget. The Progressive Front criticized the National Alliance budget. Priya Desai opposes Elena Vale on health spending.

title: Reed stays cautious
text: Jonas Reed refused to endorse the Carbon Tax Bill. The Liberty Party did not support the Workers Federation strike.

title: Foreign backing rumours
text: Kestria reportedly backs the Green Union campaign. Priya Desai met with Kestria officials in the capital.
